Residential lease for Tenant: Casey Rowan, Unit 4 at Cedar Court. Monthly rent is 1250 dollars, payable on the first day of each month. A security deposit of 1800 dollars is held separately from rent. The lease begins on 2026-12-01 and ends on 2027-11-30. Notice to end the lease must be delivered in writing 60 days before the end date. Pets require written approval. The landlord maintains common areas. The tenant must report leaks promptly and may not sublet without written consent. This excerpt does not state local legal rights or penalties beyond the written terms. 
Additional terms and administrative context:
The tenant is responsible for electricity and must keep exits clear. Routine inspection requires prior written notice. Repair requests should identify the affected room and the nature of the fault; urgent leaks should be reported immediately. Keys are returned at the end of occupancy. A move-in inventory records existing damage, and both parties should retain a copy. This paragraph does not change the rent, deposit, notice period or dates above.

Appointment letter from Cedar Clinic for Jordan Vale. The appointment is on 2026-12-08 at 09:30, in Room 204, North Building. Bring photo identification and the referral letter. Call the clinic if an interpreter is needed. This visit is a consultation; this letter contains no test results, diagnosis or medication advice. The receptionist can explain parking and step-free access. Arrive 15 minutes early to check in. Do not stop any medication based on this administrative letter. 
Additional terms and administrative context:
Please use the reception entrance rather than the emergency department. A supporter may accompany you if required. If travel arrangements change, call the clinic to reschedule rather than assuming a new appointment. Administrative staff cannot interpret medical results. Visitors should follow the building signs. The letter does not authorise treatment or change prescriptions. Keep a copy of the letter for check-in; the room and appointment date above remain the confirmed details.
